semantics.OK: All contracted work completed and required artifacts validated.
semantics.OK_WITH_GAPS: Contracted work completed and artifacts validated, with explicit bounded coverage gaps.
semantics.SKIPPED: The work was inapplicable or not requested under an edge-authorized skip reason, with supporting evidence.
semantics.BLOCKED: Required evidence, authorization, capability, or upstream state was unavailable before work could complete.
semantics.FAILED: Execution or validation failed after work began or the result could not be recorded reliably.
semantics.CANCELED: An authorized cancellation stopped execution; cancellation is not success and cannot be accepted as output.
semantics.UNRESOLVED: Bounded work completed but the contracted question could not be resolved; uncertainty and follow-up are recorded.
semantics.SUPERSEDED: Acceptance-view disposition for an immutable older attempt replaced by a named newer attempt; it is not an execution status.
